propositions: A repository-verifiable AC retagged [operator-attested] bypassed the evidence-kind criterion (nondeterministic LLM judgment) and missing-provenance detection (advisory-tier lint) to reach close-path acceptance
The completion verifier accepts tagged ACs at face value per ADR-0043 design, so the rejection point must be the plan-review gate deterministically before LLM execution
A new close-path precheck (ensure_attested_items_valid) blocks tagged ACs that cite exact repo paths/symbols or lack valid provenance continuation lines, with split remediation for mixed criteria

The attestation-launder detector fires on tagged ACs with test-shaped repo citations (tests/ paths, pytest nodes, test_* symbols) unconditionally, and on other repo citations (src/, docs/) only when preceded by evidence-introducing keywords, exempting Gerrit/commit provenance
Retagging or adding provenance lines after plan-review certification stales the attestation signature; re-review is mandatory and documented
